target: Move desktop-commander to a host-run macOS singleton (launchd plist + host wrapper, catalog lifecycle host-singleton) and remove the Linux container.
invariants: macOS automation executes on the host — never in a Linux container.
mcp_catalog.yaml stays the single source of truth: the compose service is removed and the host-singleton entry added in the same commit; generated configs come from `dopemux mcp generate`.

commit.message: feat(mcp): desktop-commander host-run singleton; retire Linux container

pr.title: feat(mcp): desktop-commander → host-run macOS singleton
pr.body:
Executes the catalog follow_on_decision (delete-or-host-run) per user decision 2026-07-18: host-run. Adds launchd plist + host wrapper with health probe, updates catalog lifecycle to host-singleton, removes the facade container (compose.yml:591 region).

Anchor: claudedocs/mcp-fleet-reconciliation-2026-07-18.md (P7/HRD).

steps.task: Create the host wrapper + launchd plist (ops/launchd/) running desktop-commander natively on macOS, loopback-bound, with a health probe. Apply the token-safe response pattern from the archived validation notes (return file paths, never base64 payloads).
validation: launchctl load starts the service; health probe reports healthy; a benign macOS automation call (e.g. osascript no-op) succeeds through MCP (evidence in proof).

steps.task: Remove the compose desktop-commander service, update mcp_catalog.yaml (lifecycle host-singleton, resolved follow_on_decision), regenerate client configs.
validation: compose.yml contains no desktop-commander service; `docker compose config` parses.
`dopemux mcp generate` output includes the host-singleton entry and the catalog drift check passes.
